name: SkyFactory4
description: SkyFactory 4 - 4.2.4 Modded Minecraft Server Back again for more modded skyblock fun! SkyFactory 4 offers a brand-new experience never before seen in the series. Full automation, tech, magic, and bacon resources! This iteration offers over 30+ world types so you can play the pack like never before! While some world types are based on the classic tree on dirt others are designed with unique recipes and advancements. Version 4.2.2 Setup: [li]You must accept the EULA by setting the EULA variable to true or the install will fail. Optional: [li]You can setup a comma separated list of players who will have admin privileges in game by setting OPS

paths.name: Installed Location
paths.description: Path to store the installed server files.

ports.name: Port
ports.description: Port for the server. Ignored if using a dedicated IP for the container.

variables.name: EULA
variables.description: Do you agree to the Mojang EULA available at https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula? Server will not start without accepting.

variables.name: OPS
variables.description: Comma separated list of players to have op capability

variables.name: LEVEL
variables.description: Name of the world directory. It is usually world.
